title: case_party.registered payload (v1)
description: Wire payload of `case_party.registered`. Publishes the ROLE and the fact that a party exists on the case - never the party handle, and never anything that could identify a person (Framework hard invariant 1). No field in this payload carries an identity attribute, a global person identifier, a party or authority handle, a document or its bytes, message content, an authentication secret, or any ballot/vote/tally/delegation reference (PACK-09 required invariants 1, 11, 12 and 13; Framework 0.8.1 section 11).
